info.title: Eternet.Agents.Control.Cli
info.description: Local deterministic agent harness CLI for Eternet mediator diagnostics and remediation planning.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: diagnose
commands.description: Read existing SARIF artifacts and return normalized diagnostics.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path to inspect.

options.name: --rules
options.description: Comma-separated rule IDs to include.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path to inspect.

options.name: --symbol
options.description: Mediator feature, handler, or file symbol.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Create remediation recipes for a diagnostic.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path to inspect.

options.name: --diagnostic
options.description: Diagnostic ID to plan, such as EAR001 or EM005.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Compare diagnostics and optionally run dotnet build/test.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path to verify.

options.name: --target
options.description: Human-readable feature, project, or pipeline being verified.

options.name: --rules
options.description: Comma-separated rule IDs to summarize after verification.

options.name: --before-count
options.description: Diagnostic count captured before external edits.

options.name: --before-ids
options.description: Comma-separated diagnostic IDs captured before edits.

options.name: --build
options.description: Optional dotnet build command line, for example: "dotnet build --no-restore".

options.name: --tests
options.description: Optional dotnet test command line, for example: "dotnet test --no-build".

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]

commands.name: reason
commands.description: Ask Copilot or Codex for read-only reasoning.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path to inspect in read-only mode.

options.name: --backend
options.description: AI backend: copilot or codex.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Reasoning request.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model ID. [default: gpt-5.4]

options.name: --reasoning-effort
options.description: Reasoning effort: minimal, low, medium, high, or xhigh. [default: high]

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description: Comma-separated diagnostic IDs.

options.name: --changed-files
options.description: Comma-separated changed file paths.

options.name: --verification-evidence
options.description: Comma-separated verification evidence entries.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]
